description: Representative speakers for the compare-voices skill: one male and one female per voice outcome, each with a real in-game line from the OSRS wiki transcript named in source.

cases.name: Hans
cases.line: You are in Lumbridge Castle, in the Kingdom of Misthalin. Across the river, the road leads north to Varrock, and to the west lies Draynor Village.

cases.name: Aggie
cases.line: I pick mine from the woods south of Varrock. The food shop in Port Sarim sometimes has some as well.

cases.name: Wydin
cases.line: We have this really exotic fruit all the way from Karamja. It's called a banana.

cases.name: Hetty
cases.line: You need an eye of newt, a rat's tail, an onion... Oh and a piece of burnt meat.

cases.name: Edmond
cases.line: If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.

cases.name: Elena
cases.line: Go and see my father, I'll make sure he adequately rewards you. Now I'd better leave while I still can.

cases.name: Guildmaster Lars
cases.line: My name is Lars, and I am the founder of the woodcutting guild. I originally grew up in a Shayzien camp, and was raised on the battlefield.

cases.name: Captain Ginea
cases.line: Gangs. It's the gangs from the slums in the east. Those ruffians are always hatching schemes, whether it's smuggling or extortion or even plain street violence.

cases.name: Mandrith
cases.line: I collect valuable resources and pawn off access to them to foolish adventurers, like yourself.

cases.name: Krystilia
cases.line: Before I assign you anything, I want to make something clear. My tasks have to be done in the Wilderness. Only kills inside the Wilderness will count.

cases.name: Regulus Cento
cases.line: Nilsal, adventurer. The name is Regulus Cento, one of the quetzal keepers for the Royal Family of Varlamore.

cases.name: Guildmaster Apatura
cases.line: Well, I'm Apatura. Let me welcome you to our small corner of Varlamore.

cases.name: Ali Morrisane
cases.line: Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.

cases.name: Leela
cases.line: My suggestion is that you pretend to be interested in joining her bandits. From there, you should be able to steer the conversation towards the key.

cases.name: Dr Fenkenstrain
cases.line: I'm sorry, but I don't think you have the aptitude for this position.

cases.name: Alice
cases.line: The curse of undeath was so cruel; all the men out here succumbed, but Lyra and I were left alive.

cases.name: Shanomi
cases.line: A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.

cases.missing: no Human Female with ethnicity easternlands in npc-voices.json (only males Shanomi and Ak-Haranu)

cases.name: Brimstail
cases.line: It's always a pleasure to catch up with an another mage! Especially one who has helped me so much!

cases.name: Femi
cases.line: Could you help me lift these boxes? They are really heavy!

cases.name: Nulodion
cases.line: Hmmmmmm... I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!

cases.name: Agmundi
cases.line: If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.

cases.name: Orlando Smith
cases.line: But to be deadset with you, I wasn't paying much attention to me boss over there and I've done a bit of a rush job.

cases.missing: byId 6001 (Orlando Smith) is the only Australian NPC and is male

cases.name: Hari
cases.line: I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?

cases.missing: byId 1325 (Hari) is the only New Zealand NPC and is male
no bundled NPC is Indian; the region is reached only by a typed Your Accent or an NPC accent override naming India
no bundled NPC is Indian; the region is reached only by a typed Your Accent or an NPC accent override naming India

cases.name: Sigmund The Merchant
cases.line: Hello outerlander. By the laws of our tribe, I am afraid I may not speak to you without the express permission of the chieftain.

cases.name: Yrsa
cases.line: I'm sorry outerlander, I cannot sell you any clothes. Our customs forbid it.

cases.name: Awowogei
cases.line: I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.

cases.name: Hamab
cases.line: Would you like to buy or sell some crafting equipment?

cases.name: General Bentnoze
cases.line: We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour. Brown get boring after a bit. We want change.

cases.name: Zanik
cases.line: A giant frog found its way into the mines, but I helped the guards to drive it off!

cases.name: Dad
cases.line: What tiny human do in troll arena? Dad challenge human to fight!

cases.name: Aga
cases.line: I not know if he love Aga, He say he will show he love by bringing me flower Trollweiss.

cases.group: Age: old speakers narrowed to the oldest voices
cases.name: Dr Harlow
cases.line: Yesh, Count Draynor! The evil nashty vampyre that no one's ever sheen! Every nowsh and then, some adventurer... theysh go and try to kill him, but none of 'em ever comesh back.

cases.group: Age: old speakers narrowed to the oldest voices
cases.name: Aggie
cases.line: Black dye can be made by grinding up black mushrooms. That's dead easy. The mushrooms grow in some old caves and ruins.

cases.name: Schoolboy
cases.line: I wanna be an archaeologist when I grow up!

cases.name: Schoolgirl
cases.line: Teacher! Can we go to the Natural History exhibit now?

cases.name: Ali the Leaflet Dropper
cases.line: I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.

cases.name: Rory
cases.line: I'm hungry!
So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
Traiborn digs around in the pockets of his robes. After a few moments he triumphantly presents you with a spinach roll.

cases.name: Arianwyn
cases.line: Many years ago, all elves lived in harmony within the crystal city of Prifddinas alongside our goddess, Seren.

cases.name: Eluned
cases.line: That I do. It is elvish tradition to plant a specially enchanted crystal seed at the graves of our ancestors. The seed will create guardians to protect the area.

cases.name: Kruk
cases.line: However, I'm afraid that this is the end of the line for you.

cases.missing: no female gorilla NPC in the table

cases.name: Necrovarus
cases.line: Get out of my sight! Or I promise you that you will regret your insolence for the rest of eternity!

cases.name: Velorina
cases.line: Take pity on me, please, eternity stretches out before me and I am helpless in its grasp.

cases.name: Demon butler
cases.line: Greetings! I am Alathazdrar, butler to the Demon Lords, and I offer thee my services for a mere 10000 coins!

cases.name: Lithil
cases.line: Alright! I heard there were other demons in Morytania, other than that oaf, Mazchna. I've come looking for them.

cases.name: Professor Oddenstein
cases.line: Oh, he isn't normally a chicken, or at least he wasn't until he helped me test my pouletmorph machine.

cases.missing: no female Wizard-race NPC in the table

cases.name: Elder Korel
cases.line: That's not surprising, but it's good that she did. She would have been unlikely to survive that injury on her own.

cases.name: Floopa
cases.line: Help? No, I'll be fine now. I can sort the rest out myself.

cases.missing: only male Icyene ids are the non-speaking Zilyana pet

cases.name: Efaritay Hallow
cases.line: No. Sugadinti suggested that we rename Morytania back to Hallowvale, but I declined. Hallowvale will never exist again. It is nothing more than a memory now.

cases.name: Tyss
cases.line: Tread carefully in this hallowed place, traveller. The magicks of the Dark Altar are not to be treated lightly.

cases.name: Aretha
cases.line: However, the Soul Altar provides a beacon, drawing the souls to this place where they may join the River.

cases.name: Mysterious Stranger
cases.line: Greetings, friend. I have something for you, if you desire.

cases.name: Mysterious Stranger
cases.line: The Theatre is owned by Lady Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble. I represent a party that has certain... interests in Verzik.

cases.name: Floki
cases.line: Woof woof!

cases.name: Stray dog
cases.line: Bark bark bark!

cases.name: Crab
cases.line: I'm still waiting for the bit where this wasn't a terrible idea.

cases.name: Crab
cases.line: So I look at him from afar when he doesn't know I'm around. Yet among a thousand crabs on the beach, he's the only one I see.

cases.name: KGP Agent
cases.line: Once inside, go into the room to the left. You'll be debriefed there. No dawdling!

cases.missing: no female penguin NPC in the table

cases.name: General Hining
cases.line: Yes, is there anything I can help with? I'm General of what's left of this army and I'm rather busy.

cases.missing: no speaking Human female with ethnicity tirannwn in the table (only a Prifddinas pet id)

cases.name: Trufitus
cases.line: Greetings Bwana! I am Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai village.

cases.name: Layleen
cases.line: Hello there... thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.

cases.name: Cormac
cases.line: We're learnin' to live a bit differently now that the Angel's gone... It feels a little odd, but we be makin' the best of it.

cases.name: Catriona
cases.line: I hear you found Keenan. Shame about what happened, but not surprising. Hopefully this is the last time that sort of thing happens.

cases.name: Jex
cases.line: Of course. The lesser gods, or avatars as some call them, were born from the dreams of Tumeken. They are Apmeken, Het, Crondis and Scabaras.

cases.name: Nathifa
cases.line: Not great. I'd just gone over there to purchase some goods from the market. When I got back to the gates, they'd been sealed shut.

cases.name: Tool Leprechaun
cases.line: Ah, 'tis a foine day to be sure! Were yez wantin' me to store yer tools, or maybe ye might be wantin' yer stuff back from me?

cases.missing: no female leprechaun NPC in the table

cases.name: Vanstrom Klause
cases.line: That someone is not you. I am in charge of blood tithing. I alone decide how it is to be carried out.

cases.name: Vanescula Drakan
cases.line: You may not like what I did, but whether you accept it or not, Lowerniel was only defeated thanks to me.

cases.name: TzHaar-Mej-Jal
cases.line: Indeed, JalYt. You want to sell it back? I swap it for 8,000 TokKul if you want.

cases.missing: TzHaar are all tabled Male; no female TzHaar
no speaking NPC named dragon/wyvern/wyrm/drake with a 6+ word line (Prince Black Dragon pet only says 'You're overthinking this.' and also hits the royalty keyword)

cases.name: Imp
cases.line: One day I get big revenge. Master's lair will be mine!

cases.missing: no female imp NPC in the table

cases.name: Fairy Godfather
cases.line: Ah, iz-a you. I make-a you an offer, eh? Iz-a good offer. You can't-a refuse it.

cases.name: Fairy Nuff
cases.line: Well, the gold that you humans are so fond of has no real value in Zanaris, so I ask my patients to pay me in gems.

cases.name: Ogre trader
cases.line: Arr, small thing wants my food, does it? I'll teach you to deal with ogres!

cases.missing: no female ogre NPC in the table

cases.name: Restless ghost
cases.line: WOW! This is INCREDIBLE! I didn't expect anyone to ever understand me again!

cases.name: Spirit Angler
cases.line: Sorry, I'm quite busy preparing to face Tempoross. Captain Pudi by the dock can answer any questions you might have.

cases.name: Pirate Pete
cases.line: I may have a quest, but you don't look like you'd be able to handle the kind of monsters I have problems with.

cases.name: Pirate Jackie the Fruit
cases.line: Arr, ye have that, I see yer list. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward then!

cases.name: Barbarian guard
cases.line: If you're a barbarian you need to be able to drink like one. We barbarians like a good drink.

cases.name: Barbarian
cases.line: Ha ha ha! Little adventurer wants to buy me a drink, how sweet.

cases.name: Wizard Traiborn
cases.line: Those pesky thingummywuts. They get everywhere. They leave a terrible mess too.

cases.name: Wizard Persten
cases.line: No offence taken! My research tends to take me far from the Wizards' Tower. I've been all across Gielinor and even to some other planes of existence!

cases.name: Abbot Langley
cases.line: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!

cases.name: Priestess Zul-Gwenwynig
cases.line: Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.

cases.name: King Roald
cases.line: You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!

cases.name: Queen Ellamaria
cases.line: I shall not allow you to climb my trellis, peasant. Only providing your assistance to my project might cause me to reconsider.

cases.name: Sir Amik Varze
cases.line: Well adventurer, now that you are a White Knight, I expect you should be out there hunting Black Knights for us!

cases.name: Void Knight
cases.line: I'm a Void Knight, one of the order of Guthix. We are warriors of balance who do Guthix's work here in Gielinor.

cases.name: Lord Kandur Hosidius
cases.line: Hosidius is home to the farmers and chefs of Kourend. We are the main food supplier to the kingdom and we ensure that her people are fed.

cases.name: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
cases.line: That's why I formed the Saviours of Kourend. We take the laws into our own hands and fight against all who would damage this city, no matter who they are.
